title: Find the first repeated value
statement: Return the first value encountered while scanning left to right that has already appeared earlier. Return the language's empty optional value when no value repeats. The returned value is determined by the second occurrence, not by which duplicated value appeared earliest initially.
constraints: use the exact declared optional result type
preserve input order when deciding which duplicate is first
inputs contain at most 10000 int64 values
do not throw, panic, perform input/output, add tests, or suppress static diagnostics

jett.signature:
namespace benchmark

function first_duplicate(values: list[int64]) returns optional[int64]

forbidden_patterns.message: Python type bypasses such as Any, casts, and ignored diagnostics are forbidden
raising exceptions is forbidden; return None
